title: Japanese hanging, wearing, telephone, and time-use verb contrasts

provenance.sentence_provenance: All six Japanese sentences were written for this draft. No dictionary examples, corpora, or external sentence text were copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: First-party Taiwan Traditional Chinese references for the original examples, with independent language review.

purpose: Draft a narrow development-only contrast for common physical hanging, wearing glasses, telephone-call, and time-spent uses of 掛ける, with distinct 賭ける and 駆ける controls.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: The six original rows cover these four specific uses and two distinct-verb controls. They do not score the fixed sample.

items.jp: 作業員は濡れた上着を物干し竿に掛けた。
items.zh_hant: 工作人員把濕外套掛在曬衣桿上。
semantic_checks: 作業員 is the agent; 濡れた上着を is the item moved; 物干し竿に is the support where it is hung.
掛けた is transitive 掛ける with a physical hanging sense.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state whose coat it is or whether it later dries.

control.source_cue: 作業員 is the agent; 濡れた上着を is the item moved; 物干し竿に is the support where it is hung.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples physical_hanging for 掛ける.
limits: This row samples only its stated contrast and does not define every use of 掛ける.

items.jp: 読書を始める前に、彼女は眼鏡を掛けた。
items.zh_hant: 她開始閱讀前戴上眼鏡。
semantic_checks: 彼女 is the agent and 眼鏡 is the item put on; this is the wearing-glasses use of 掛ける.
The source states the timing but does not say whether she needs the glasses for vision or protection.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state what she reads or where she is.

control.source_cue: 彼女 is the agent and 眼鏡 is the item put on; this is the wearing-glasses use of 掛ける.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples put_on_glasses for 掛ける.
limits: This row samples only its stated contrast and does not define every use of 掛ける.

items.jp: 担当者は受付に電話を掛けた。
semantic_checks: 担当者 is the caller; 受付に marks the call destination; 電話を掛けた means placing a call.
This is the telephone sense, not physically hanging a telephone.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state whether the call connected or what was discussed.

control.source_cue: 担当者 is the caller; 受付に marks the call destination; 電話を掛けた means placing a call.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples make_telephone_call for 掛ける.
limits: This row samples only its stated contrast and does not define every use of 掛ける.

items.jp: 担当者は機械の点検に二時間かけた。
items.zh_hant: 負責人花了兩小時檢查機器。
semantic_checks: 担当者 is the person who spent the time; 二時間 is the duration; 機械の点検に is the task.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state whether the inspection found a problem.

control.source_cue: 担当者 is the person who spent the time; 二時間 is the duration; 機械の点検に is the task.

items.jp: チームは決勝戦の勝利に全てを賭けた。
items.zh_hant: 隊伍把一切都押在決賽勝利上。
semantic_checks: チーム is the agent; 全てを is what is staked; 決勝戦の勝利に is the outcome wagered on.
賭ける is a distinct transitive lemma and must not be treated as 掛ける.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state the result of the final or what 全て includes.

control.source_cue: チーム is the agent; 全てを is what is staked; 決勝戦の勝利に is the outcome wagered on.

items.jp: 選手はゴールまで駆けた。
semantic_checks: 選手 is the moving participant and ゴールまで marks the endpoint.
駆けた is the distinct intransitive lemma 駆ける, not transitive 掛ける.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state the distance, speed, or race result.
